nina: Quick kickoff / benchmark launch — need 2 charts + gated calculator + short webinar. audience: devs and infra buyers.
arjun: Charts: panel A = $ per 1k tokens across model+quant settings; panel B = p95 latency vs $ per 1k requests. annotate batching knee.
cass: Design: single-color palette, dashed lines for fallbacks, callout box for "knee" with % savings. export social PNG 1200x630.
joel: Funnel mapping: signup asks "monthly tokens" -> tag 'bench_interest'; <50k self-serve, 50-500k nurture, >500k SDR. route >250k to sales.
benchbot: bench dataset: https://internal.benchmarks.redwood/175765 file: bench-econ-2026.csv (batching on/off, q8/q4 variants).
arjun: Captions: "Throughput and quantization change unit economics" and "Tail latency vs cost: choose your SLO." Simple language.
nina: Webinar (12m): problem, live demo (dashboard+calc), ops playbook. CTA: "Calculate your token bill" -> gated sheet + API sample.
arjun: sample curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/calc -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-q4","tokens":1000,"batch":8}'
cass: UX: add microcopy "estimate based on steady throughput; spikes vary" near calculator.
joel: I'll set up routing and test on staging by Thu. nina: timeline: numbers by Mon, visuals Tue, page & calc Fri, webinar next Wed. owners: arjun numbers, cass visuals, joel routing, nina copy. :rocket:
